identity.operation: Parse ordinary XML text with XMLDocument
identity.condition: processEntities=false and the text contains a recognized entity such as &.
identity.capability: XMLText::ParseDeep retains the entity in the text value.
identity.consequence: The entity-preserving ordinary-text mode cannot be exercised.

requirement: Parse XML with processEntities=false so a recognized entity such as & is retained in the text value.

assessment.necessity_reason: XMLDocument supports processEntities=false, which makes ordinary text retain recognized entities. The harness always uses the true default. XML input cannot change that constructor setting.

before.requirement: Parse ordinary XML text containing & with processEntities=false, retaining & in the text value.
before.reason: The harness constructs XMLDocument without arguments, so every input uses processEntities=true.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: Ordinary text parsing selects the leave-entities mode when the document setting is false.
The leave-entities mode omits the entity-processing flag.
The selected change concerns cleanup of parsed nodes.

after.requirement: Parse ordinary XML text containing & with processEntities=false, retaining & in the text value.
after.reason: The mode remains supported, while the same harness still constructs the document with the true default.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: Ordinary text parsing still selects the leave-entities mode when the document setting is false.
The leave-entities mode still omits the entity-processing flag.
The changed destructor cleans up parsed nodes.

assessment.comparison_reason: Both versions support the same constructor setting. The same default-only construction blocks it on both sides.

necessity_evidence.reason: The old harness always constructs XMLDocument with processEntities=true. Both source versions support processEntities=false for ordinary text, so the same coverage gap is preexisting. The g0001 destructor change does not alter that obligation.
necessity_evidence.finite_witness: Supported setup: construct XMLDocument(false), then parse the bytes &; the ordinary text value retains &. Actual target setup: the same bytes reach XMLDocument doc with the true default, so they cannot exercise the false mode.

scope_contract.reason: The entry's primary operation parses XML through XMLDocument. Entity processing is constructor state that controls ordinary text parsing, so it belongs to that operation's surface.

evidence.dependency_reason: Shows that ordinary text parsing uses the document's entity setting.

feasible_trigger.reason: A finite, valid XML input containing & exercises the supported leave-entities mode when XMLDocument is constructed with false; the harness fixes that argument to its true default.

evidence.dependency_reason: Defines ordinary text's leave-entities mode without entity processing.

observable_consequence.reason: The supported ordinary-text behavior of retaining a recognized entity under processEntities=false is unreachable through this entry's fixed true setting.

evidence.dependency_reason: Distinguishes processing and leave-entities text modes.
Shows recognized entities are converted when the entity-processing flag is set.

alternatives_ruled_out.reason: Input bytes cannot change the constructor argument. CDATA can retain the literal characters but takes the separate CDATA path; another spelling that yields the same text value under the true setting does not exercise ordinary-text parsing with processEntities=false.

evidence.dependency_reason: The constructor stores the supplied entity setting in the document.
CDATA and ordinary text use separate parsing paths, and only ordinary text selects by ProcessEntities().

identity_preserved.reason: The same ordinary-text, processEntities=false tuple is supported before and after. The old harness's default-only construction blocks it on both sides; g0001 changes node destruction, not this setting or parse mode.

evidence.dependency_reason: Before version selects the leave-entities mode for ordinary text when the setting is false.
Anchors the before g0001 destructor change separately from the parsing contract.
Anchors the after g0001 destructor change separately from the parsing contract.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: Before version defines the leave-entities text mode.
After version retains the leave-entities text mode.

coverage_witness.supported_behavior: With processEntities=false, ordinary XML text retains a recognized entity such as & in its text value.
coverage_witness.actual_target_setup: The entry constructs XMLDocument with no arguments, selecting processEntities=true for every input.
coverage_witness.blocked_behavior: Ordinary-text parsing with processEntities=false cannot be reached.
coverage_witness.equivalent_routes: CDATA retains literal characters through a separate path; a different entity spelling under the true setting does not exercise the false mode.
